title: Diameter of N-Ary Tree
description:
Given a `root` of an `N-ary tree`, you need to compute the length of the diameter of the tree.

The diameter of an N-ary tree is the length of the **longest** path between any two nodes in the tree. This path may or may not pass through the root.

(*Nary-Tree input serialization is represented in their level order traversal, each group of children is separated by the null value.)*

examples.explanation: Diameter is shown in red color.

constraints: The depth of the n-ary tree is less than or equal to 1000.
The total number of nodes is between [1, 10^4].
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Diameter of N-Ary Tree.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
